blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **тру́дный** — hard, difficult. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **зву́чный** — resounding, sonorous. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: а́вторский — author's; ца́рский — czarist, imperial, of the czar; да́мский — lady's, ladies'; во́инский — military, martial.
**нау́чный** — scientific. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**поря́дочный** — decent, honest, respectable. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**ручно́й** — (relational) hand; manual. Source: Wiktionary, «-ной» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ной#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ко́нский — (relational) horse, equine; бра́тский — brotherly, fraternal; морско́й — (relational) sea; росси́йский — Russian (concerning the country, nationality).
**ручная** — ручно́й: (relational) hand; manual; handmade; tame, domesticated. Wiktionary: рука́ + -но́й.
